findings.claim: For exact MemCompiler ScienceWorld counterfactual replay, task/variation/action-prefix identity alone is not sufficient evidence of the same pre-effect simulator state: the evaluated public code pins ScienceWorld 1.2.2, while the official project documents a 1.3.0 determinism fix that can change physics trajectories and observations relative to 1.2.x and supplies a concrete pre-fix same-prefix stochastic reproducer.
findings.scope: Conservative exact-replay provenance rule; does not assert that every 1.2.2 task/prefix or the particular MemCompiler Table-3 episodes are stochastic.

findings.claim: Action-prefix reconstruction should count as a restorable environment-state binding only after an exact-prefix replay-equivalence probe (or native snapshot) binds environment revision, task/variation/simplification, reset state, ordered actions and branch-state/trace digests. A 1.2.x evaluated run cannot be silently upgraded to 1.3.0 and still called the same environment because the official project explicitly warns of changed trajectories/observations.
findings.scope: Exact matched-pair replay only; current official deterministic tests directly cover specific reset/object-tree and task-1-boil traces, not every ScienceWorld task.

findings.claim: Stable source-memory identity can be lost before the receiver boundary: public CDMem ScienceWorld memory code has trajectory/vector IDs internally but recall() passes aggregated summary text to the agent. Fixed-selected-memory causality therefore needs an explicit source-identity-to-receiver-payload binding, not merely stable IDs somewhere in the memory backend.
findings.scope: Implementation-level observation for the inspected CDMem revision only.

findings.claim: The inspected CDMem ScienceWorld run surface does not pin a ScienceWorld package/JAR revision, so exact replay evidence needs a separate environment-revision binding even when memory-source IDs exist.
findings.scope: Observed public repository surface only; external or unpublished run manifests are not excluded.

protocols.name: SCIENCEWORLD_ACTION_PREFIX_REPLAY_EQUIVALENCE_GATE
protocols.rule: A matched counterfactual may use action-prefix replay as its environment-state reconstruction only when ScienceWorld package/source/JAR identity, task name, variation, simplification, step limit, reset-state digests, canonical ordered action/observation/reward/info trace, branch-state digest and repeated replay evidence are bound. Native snapshot bytes may satisfy the state identity directly. For ScienceWorld <=1.2.x the current validator requires at least an eight-run exact-prefix equality probe because official evidence contains an eight-run stochastic reproducer; this threshold is conservative and exact-prefix scoped. Cross-version or mismatched environment bindings fail the same-state claim.
protocols.test_result: 14/14 expected semantic outcomes; 14/14 cases structurally valid under Draft 2020-12 in local preflight.
protocols.scope: Replay/state-identity provenance only. No ScienceWorld simulator was executed in this run, and the protocol does not establish a memory-performance effect or package-wide determinism.
